---
title: "Sluggers"
---

```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(Lahman)

leaders <- Batting |>
	group_by(playerID) |>
	summarise(
		career_home_runs = sum(HR, na.rm = TRUE),
		first_year = min(yearID),
		last_year = max(yearID),
		.groups = "drop"
	) |>
	left_join(
		People |> select(playerID, nameFirst, nameLast),
		by = "playerID"
	) |>
	mutate(
		full_name = str_c(nameFirst, nameLast, sep = " "),
		seasons = str_c(first_year, last_year, sep = " - "),
		steroid_era = if_else(
			last_year >= 1994 & first_year <= 2009,
			"Active during steroid era",
			"Not active during steroid era"
		)
	) |>
	arrange(desc(career_home_runs)) |>
	slice_head(n = 15) |>
	select(full_name, career_home_runs, seasons, steroid_era)

ggplot(
	leaders,
	aes(
		x = career_home_runs,
		y = fct_reorder(full_name, career_home_runs),
		fill = steroid_era
	)
) +
	geom_col() +
	scale_fill_manual(
		values = c(
			"Active during steroid era" = "firebrick",
			"Not active during steroid era" = "grey60"
		),
		name = "Steroid era activity"
	) +
	labs(
		title = "Career Home Run Leaders by Steroid Era Activity",
		x = "Career home runs",
		y = "Player",
		caption = "Source: Lahman database; top 15 players by career home runs"
	)

bonds_by_season <- Batting |>
	filter(playerID == "bondsba01") |>
	group_by(yearID) |>
	summarise(
		home_runs = sum(HR, na.rm = TRUE),
		.groups = "drop"
	)

ggplot(bonds_by_season, aes(x = yearID, y = home_runs)) +
	geom_col(fill = "firebrick") +
	labs(
		title = "Barry Bonds: Home Runs by Season",
		x = "Season",
		y = "Home runs"
	)
```
